description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation - Notify the regulations of the Civil Aviation (Classification of Aerodromes) - 2018
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation under the Civil Aviation Act, No. 14 of 2010. It establishes a new regulatory framework for the classification of aerodromes in Sri Lanka, including detailed codes and criteria for different types of aerodromes based on design, use, purpose, scope, operating conditions, and landing aids. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it creates new regulatory requirements and compliance standards under existing legislation.
